title: Formula 1 - Mobile App
subtitle: Reinventing the Fan Experience
intro: The Race Experience Application, part of the Formula 1 app, allows 12 million MAU to navigate all race venues on the calendar, create a personal planner and explore the interactive map for each location.
body:
## The Challenge

Theres is no digital experience for fans attending formula 1 race weekends. Picture this: you're at a large festival without any clear itinerary and clear way of maximising your day. You rely on local signage and theres no guarantee of a map to be provided. Throw in limited connectivity for phones and you could be having an unfortunate day out.

## The Approach

We performed user research with 100's of fans at 3 different Grand Prix's: Melbourne, Imola & Silverstone. These were guerilla-style interviews stationed in multiple parts of the track. First, we wanted to understand the pains and challenges. After understanding their race experience, we would ask them to interact with our prototype. Further changes were continuously made based on user feedback and tested with new audiences.

It was clear that there was key non-negotiables for features. Firstly, connectivity being a constant challenge internationally, we adopted a offline-first experience to ensure data is cached and our application could be used with poor signal.

## The Outcome

Offline First 
A race day experience app, offering personalised schedules, interactive maps and event information We got 12 million MAU of the core app. 

**Personalized Timetables & Scheduling:** Helping fans manage their weekend with real-time updates and schedule building

**Advanced Maps & Wayfinding:** Streamlining navigation at iconic circuits to manage crowds and reduce long queues.
